CADRUMO - local-first workflow with the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT)

Cadrumo keeps taxpayer data local and exposes exactly two command roots.
The config root manages profiles, encrypted local data, recovery keys, profile sessions, AEAT authentication, and repair.
The app root manages profile overview, ledger, modelo, review, registry, and authenticated AEAT reads.
A profile stores one taxpayer's local facts and settings. The active profile is the selected taxpayer context. A profile session provides resumable access to encrypted profile data.
The ledger contains imported money movements. A modelo is an official AEAT declaration form, distinct from its local work unit or export.
The review queue contains findings that need operator action. The registry contains validated, versioned tax-rule data and sources; it holds no taxpayer data and performs no live submission.
Profile labels stay visible. Tax identities, credentials, storage identifiers, object keys, and sensitive web-address content stay protected.
For an isolated blank state, set CADRUMO_LOCAL_STORAGE_ROOT and CADRUMO_SECRET_STORE_DIR; logs default under that storage root.

Start or resume
  aeat config profile create NAME  Create the first local taxpayer profile.
  aeat config profile list         List registered profiles and identify the active one.
  aeat config login NAME           Select a profile and start or renew its session.
  aeat config profile status       Check profile readiness and its authoritative next action.
  aeat config profile edit [NAME]  Complete or correct an incomplete profile.

Core workflow
  aeat config profile status                Show profile readiness.
  aeat app overview status                  Summarize profile and work state.
  aeat app ledger import                    Import bank or accounting transactions.
  aeat app ledger review                    Review imported rows that need attention.
  aeat app modelo work --help               Create or operate modelo work units.
  aeat app modelo verification-report list  List saved filing verification reports.
  aeat app review queue                     Show profile-wide items awaiting operator review.
  aeat app registry inspect                 Inspect validated registry metadata and sources.

Resume or recover
  aeat config login NAME      Start or renew an absent, closed, or expired profile session.
  aeat config repair          Before changing configuration or stored data, run this read-only health report.
  aeat config repair profile  Inspect a reported active-profile pointer problem.

Command families
  aeat config  Open profile, session, custody, storage, and repair commands.
  aeat app     Open profile-scoped tax-work commands.

Diagnostics
  aeat app overview status --verbose  Show general state with additional detail.
  aeat --format json config repair    Return the complete local health report as JSON.
  aeat config repair logs             Show the log path and latest lines.
  aeat --version --detail             Show the package and registry fingerprint.

Profile authentication options
  --profile-secrets-stdin  Read the exact target profile passphrase from one bounded JSON object on standard input after session resume fails.
  --profile-secrets-fd FD  Read the exact target profile passphrase from one bounded JSON object on an inherited readable descriptor after session resume fails.

Add --help for details. Remove sensitive log values, then report bugs at github.com/nevenincs/cadrumo/issues.

Usage: aeat config login [OPTIONS] [name]

  Authenticate a profile and start a resumable session

Arguments:
  name  Profile UUID or exact label to log in; omit to use the selected
        profile

Options:
  --secrets-stdin                 Read the secrets as one bounded JSON object
                                  from standard input instead of prompting.
  --secrets-fd <int>              File descriptor to read machine secrets
                                  from.
  --output-language, --language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  Output language for the response text (es,
                                  en, ca, hu).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Usage: aeat config profile create [OPTIONS] [profile_name]

  Initialize a new active profile.

Arguments:
  profile_name  Profile name to write the answers into

Options:
  --quiet                         Run non-interactively using only the
                                  supplied flag values; required flags left
                                  unset cause an error. Sufficient on its own;
                                  combine with --accept-defaults to fill the
                                  rest from descriptor defaults.
  --accept-defaults               Fill every unsupplied flag from the
                                  descriptor defaults, without prompting. Use
                                  alongside --quiet, or on its own for an all-
                                  defaults create.
  --output-language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  CLI output language for this profile
  --entity-type <str>             Natural person, legal entity, or attribution
                                  entity
  --legal-entity-form <str>       Recognised legal form when the entity type
                                  is a legal entity
  --tax-id <str>                  Tax identifier (NIF/CIF/DNI/NIE) for the
                                  active profile
  --name <str>                    Display name shown in local reviews
  --surnames <str>                Surnames or company name for export headers
  --legal-name <str>              Legal or company name for legal-entity
                                  export headers
  --fiscal-residency <str>        Fiscal residency category: resident_irpf
                                  (habitual resident in Spain) or
                                  non_resident_irnr (non-resident, IRNR
                                  taxation RDLeg 5/2004).
  --country-of-fiscal-residence <str>
                                  ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of
                                  fiscal residence (e.g. GB, DE, FR). Required
                                  when fiscal-residency is non_resident_irnr.
  --representante-fiscal-nif <str>
                                  NIF/NIE of the fiscal representative in
                                  Spain. Required for non-EU/EEA non-residents
                                  (Art. 47 LGT + Art. 10 TRLIRNR RDLeg
                                  5/2004).
  --representante-fiscal-nombre <str>
                                  Full name of the fiscal representative in
                                  Spain.
  --tax-residence-jurisdiction-scope <str>
                                  Declared territorial regime: common
                                  territory or the not-yet-supported foral
                                  territory.
  --tax-residence-ccaa <str>      Tax-residence autonomous community. One of:
                                  %{choices}.
  --address-postcode <str>        Tax address postcode
  --irpf-income-categories <str>  IRPF income category; pass --irpf-income-
                                  categories once per category
  --activity <str>                Business activity as plain text, or the IAE
                                  heading if you know it
  --activity-start-date <str>     Censo registration / start-of-activity date
                                  (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when set,
                                  obligations for periods before this date are
                                  not shown.
  --incn-prior-12-months <str>    Net turnover (importe neto de la cifra de
                                  negocios) over the prior 12 months, in
                                  euros. Above 6,000,000 EUR Modelo 202
                                  mandates the Art. 40.3 LIS modality; below
                                  it both modalities are available. Optional.
  --new-entity-first-two-profit-periods, --no-new-entity-first-two-profit-periods
                                  Mark this when a newly-created legal entity
                                  is in one of its first two profit-making tax
                                  periods (LIS Art. 29) to opt into the 15
                                  percent reduced rate. Optional; unset leaves
                                  the entity on its otherwise-applicable rate.
  --ley-49-2002-option-declared, --no-ley-49-2002-option-declared
                                  Record whether Modelo 036 casilla 651
                                  declares the Ley 49/2002 Title II option.
  --ley-49-2002-option-date <str>
                                  Record the Modelo 036 casilla 653 date for
                                  the Ley 49/2002 Title II option.
  --ley-49-2002-renunciation-declared, --no-ley-49-2002-renunciation-declared
                                  Record whether Modelo 036 casilla 652
                                  declares renunciation of the Ley 49/2002
                                  Title II regime.
  --ley-49-2002-renunciation-date <str>
                                  Record the Modelo 036 casilla 654 date for
                                  the Ley 49/2002 Title II renunciation.
  --iva-regime <str>              IVA regime
  --iva-m303-regime-composition <str>
                                  Modelo 303 regime composition: general,
                                  simplified, or mixed.
  --iva-roi-enrolled, --no-iva-roi-enrolled
                                  Enrolled in ROI
  --iva-oss-enrolled, --no-iva-oss-enrolled
                                  Enrolled in OSS
  --iva-group-member-enrolled, --no-iva-group-member-enrolled
                                  Enrolled as a member entity of an IVA group
  --iva-group-dominant-entity-enrolled, --no-iva-group-dominant-entity-enrolled
                                  Enrolled as the dominant entity of an IVA
                                  group
  --iva-sii-enrolled, --no-iva-sii-enrolled
                                  Whether the taxpayer is enrolled in the SII
  --iva-redeme-enrolled, --no-iva-redeme-enrolled
                                  Whether the taxpayer is registered in REDEME
  --iva-intracommunity-operations-exceed-50000-eur, --no-iva-intracommunity-operations-exceed-50000-eur
                                  Intra-community operations exceed 50,000 EUR
  --iva-cash-accounting-regime-enrolled, --no-iva-cash-accounting-regime-enrolled
                                  Declare enrolment in the special IVA cash-
                                  accounting regime.
  --iva-voluntary-sii-enrolled, --no-iva-voluntary-sii-enrolled
                                  Declare voluntary SII enrolment separately
                                  from mandatory inclusion triggers.
  --iva-hydrocarbon-deposit-advance-payment-deduction-entitled, --no-iva-hydrocarbon-deposit-advance-payment-deduction-entitled
                                  Declare entitlement to deduct advance
                                  payments under the hydrocarbon tax-deposit
                                  regime.
  --enrollment-large-company, --no-enrollment-large-company
                                  Large-company enrollment
  --enrollment-public-administration-budget-gt-6000000, --no-enrollment-public-administration-budget-gt-6000000
                                  Public administration budget over 6,000,000
  --taxation-type <str>           Income-tax return type: 1 = individual, 2 =
                                  joint (family unit).
  --taxpayer-sex <str>            First taxpayer sex: H = male, M = female.
  --taxpayer-marital-status <str>
                                  First taxpayer marital status: 1 = single, 2
                                  = married, 3 = widowed, 4 = separated or
                                  divorced, 5 = registered civil partnership.
  --situacion-familiar <str>      Family situation under Art. 82 LIRPF:
                                  determines whether joint taxation is
                                  available and which family unit variant
                                  applies.
  --taxpayer-marriage-date <str>  Start date of the current marriage (YYYY-MM-
                                  DD). Only when marital status = 2 (married).
                                  Derives casillas 0245/0246/0247 (matrimonio
                                  sobrevenido, Art. 82 LIRPF).
  --taxpayer-birth-date <str>     First taxpayer birth date
  --taxpayer-disability-grade <str>
                                  First taxpayer disability grade: 1 =
                                  33%-64%, 2 = 65% or higher, 3 = judicial
                                  incapacity, 4 = third-party assistance or
                                  reduced mobility.
  --taxpayer-death-date <str>     First taxpayer death date
  --spouse-tax-id <str>           Spouse NIF/NIE
  --spouse-name <str>             Spouse given name
  --spouse-surnames <str>         Spouse surnames
  --spouse-birth-date <str>       Spouse birth date
  --spouse-sex <str>              Spouse sex: H = male, M = female.
  --spouse-disability-grade <str>
                                  Spouse disability grade (if applicable): 1 =
                                  33%-64%, 2 = 65% or higher, 3 = judicial
                                  incapacity, 4 = third-party assistance or
                                  reduced mobility.
  --spouse-non-resident-irpf, --no-spouse-non-resident-irpf
                                  Spouse is non-resident IRPF
  --spouse-eu-eea-resident, --no-spouse-eu-eea-resident
                                  Spouse is EU/EEA resident
  --spouse-eu-eea-country <str>   Spouse EU/EEA country
  --family-descendants-eu-eea-deduction, --no-family-descendants-eu-eea-deduction
                                  EU/EEA descendants in family-unit deduction
  --family-minor-children-in-unit, --no-family-minor-children-in-unit
                                  Minor children in family unit
  --has-employees, --no-has-employees
                                  Has employees and pays salaries with
                                  retención
  --pays-professionals-with-retencion, --no-pays-professionals-with-retencion
                                  Pays professionals with retención
  --art109-activity-income-withholding-ge-70pct, --no-art109-activity-income-withholding-ge-70pct
                                  Art. 109 coverage - at least 70% of covered
                                  professional, agricultural, livestock, or
                                  forestry activity income subject to
                                  withholding or payment on account
  --pays-rent-with-retencion, --no-pays-rent-with-retencion
                                  Pays local rent with retención
  --pays-capital-income-with-retencion, --no-pays-capital-income-with-retencion
                                  Pays capital income with retención
  --modelo-111-no-retenciones-periods <str>
                                  Comma-separated Modelo 111 no-obligation
                                  periods, format YYYY:PERIOD (for example
                                  2025:2T,2025:3T). Use only when no subject
                                  payments were made.
  --irpf-estimation-regime <str>  IRPF estimation regime for economic-activity
                                  income
  --objective-estimation-modulos-iae-epigraph <str>
                                  IAE epigraph for objective-estimation
                                  modules, such as 972.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-1-units <str>
                                  Annual module 1 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-2-units <str>
                                  Annual module 2 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-3-units <str>
                                  Annual module 3 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-4-units <str>
                                  Annual module 4 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-5-units <str>
                                  Annual module 5 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-6-units <str>
                                  Annual module 6 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --objective-estimation-modulos-module-7-units <str>
                                  Annual module 7 units for objective-
                                  estimation modules.
  --irpf-special-regime <str>     IRPF special regime. "general" for most
                                  taxpayers. "impatriado" for workers who
                                  relocated to Spain and elected the Beckham
                                  Law regime (Art. 93 LIRPF), available for
                                  the first 6 years after relocation.
  --irpf-special-regime-start-date <str>
                                  Date the worker elected the inpatriate
                                  regime (YYYY-MM-DD). Only when irpf-special-
                                  regime is "impatriado". RIRPF Art. 116. The
                                  regime expires at the end of the 6th
                                  calendar year.
  --does-intracomunitario, --no-does-intracomunitario
                                  Conducts intracomunitario operations
  --third-party-transactions-above-347-threshold, --no-third-party-transactions-above-347-threshold
                                  Third-party transactions exceed Modelo 347
                                  threshold
  --bienes-extranjero-above-threshold, --no-bienes-extranjero-above-threshold
                                  Foreign-held assets above legal threshold
  --monedas-virtuales-extranjero-above-threshold, --no-monedas-virtuales-extranjero-above-threshold
                                  Virtual currencies held abroad above Modelo
                                  721 threshold
  --llm-vision, --no-llm-vision   Enable on-host LLM vision for reading
                                  invoices.
  --google-export, --no-google-export
                                  Enable Google Sheets export.
  --notes <str>                   Notes for your own records (optional)
  --secrets-stdin                 Read the secrets as one bounded JSON object
                                  from standard input instead of prompting.
  --secrets-fd <int>              File descriptor to read machine secrets
                                  from.
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Usage: aeat config passphrase change [OPTIONS]

  Change the passphrase without re-encrypting records or invalidating a
  recovery phrase.

Options:
  --secrets-stdin                 Read the secrets as one bounded JSON object
                                  from standard input instead of prompting.
  --secrets-fd <int>              File descriptor to read machine secrets
                                  from.
  --output-language, --language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  Output language for the response text (es,
                                  en, ca, hu).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Usage: aeat config profile restore [OPTIONS] {label}

  Republish a profile capsule from a directory; add --artifact to recover with
  the 24-word phrase.

Arguments:
  label  Display name for the restored profile.  [required]

Options:
  --file <path>                   Path to the unpublished capsule directory to
                                  restore.  [required]
  --artifact <file>               Recovery artifact file; use it when the
                                  profile password is lost.
  --secrets-stdin                 Read the secrets as one bounded JSON object
                                  from standard input instead of prompting.
  --secrets-fd <int>              File descriptor to read machine secrets
                                  from.
  --output-language, --language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  Output language for the response text (es,
                                  en, ca, hu).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Usage: aeat config auth certificate secret set [OPTIONS]

  Set (or rotate) the passphrase for a registered certificate source

Options:
  --name <str>                    Registered certificate source the passphrase
                                  is bound to  [required]
  --secrets-stdin                 Read the secrets as one bounded JSON object
                                  from standard input instead of prompting.
  --secrets-fd <int>              File descriptor to read machine secrets
                                  from.
  --output-language, --language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  Output language for the response text (es,
                                  en, ca, hu).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
